notes: loop: periodic = the source cycle closes on its own (+periodExtraFrames when the take stops one frame short); seam = residual end->start mismatch is spread over the cycle; false = one-shot.

feet: contact = planted ground path (Idle sole band, never below rest); body = leg angle relative to the shoulder/hip; blend = contact while the source paw is down, body once it lifts (bodyBlend = lift/leg-length thresholds).
Walk playback is distance driven in Unity (EnemyRigMotion298 WalkMetresPerSecond), so playing a walk 'slower' is not a clip edit: the cadence follows the measured stance-foot speed.

centerStride (locomotion): the planted paw path is centred under the hip, where the near-straight Rig298 legs have the most reach; autoBodyDrop: largest pelvis lowering (fraction of the shortest standing leg) allowed to keep planted paws reachable.
attempts ladder (default): [amplitude, stride] = [1,1] [1,.85] [.85,.85] [.85,.7] [.7,.7] [.7,.55] [.55,.55]; first PASS wins.

mirror: the source is reflected across the body midplane (left/right legs swapped). Bulgasari uses it on every bear clip because its left armpit (Chest/Neck/Fore_L_Upper weights) is the weak skin; all clips are mirrored together so stances stay consistent.

fullCollapse (Death): the pelvis drop is never scaled down by the ladder. tailGroundKeep (default .9): tail joints keep this fraction of their rest ground clearance; a tail that meets the ground bends up instead of floating the body.
